title: Writing an iterator
hints: An iter.Seq[int] is just a func(yield func(int) bool). The function calls yield once per value. When range's loop body runs break, yield returns false.
After yield returns false the iterator must stop immediately. Calling yield again makes the program panic with "range function continued iteration after function for loop body returned false".
return func(yield func(int) bool) { for i := n; i >= 1; i-- { if !yield(i) { return } } }
